name: Misuzu Sasa
source:
Favorite cake: Mont Blanc, strawberry tarts

Kamiogi Academy first-year and acclaimed picture-book author/illustrator. Timid and chronically self-sabotaging, she's quick to jump to negative conclusions and run with them to perplexingly imaginative extremes... While her talents as an artist have made her a household name practically overnight, the pressure she feels to complete her next big book has sunk her into a major creative slump. She's also a huge fan of cakes and tea, and as such, is a frequent customer at Marshmallow Tree.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1369790/Marshmallow_All_the_Way_Home/]Steam[/url]]
